jobs.title: eCommerce Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The eCommerce Operations Manager is responsible for driving operational metrics for our eCommerce business including Home Delivery and Drive Up & Go and other innovative channels to service our customer in their area of responsibility.

- Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

-
Achieve P&L results and operational metric goals in stores across assigned operating area.

-
Lead Drivers and Home Shopping Department Managers in day-to-day operations to achieve their key metrics of on time tilling, on time delivery, picks per hour and out of stocks including delivery via third party logistics partners.

-
Lead the field teams through expansion, business and environment changes as needed.

-
Review eCommerce goals, metrics, and performance with store leadership on a regular basis and partner in growing the eCommerce business and overcoming roadblocks for growth.

-
Work with Region Director of eCommerce on launching innovative strategies and programs for eCommerce.

-
Set and maintain high standards of quality, productivity, efficiency, and service for our rapidly expanding business.

-
Drive a culture of exceptional customer service within the frontline eCommerce staff.

-
Ensure operational compliance with eCommerce policies and procedures.

-
Manage, interview, hire and schedule a team of 50+ employees. Inspire and motivate field staff by providing on-going recognition, coaching, and mentoring.

-
Manage fleet of 30+ delivery trucks including asset rotation, safety, and maintenance.

-
Manage the investigation of accidents, workers comp claims and traffic citations.

Qualifications:   The following are preferred :

Education Level:

-
Bachelor’s degree in business or related field and/or equivalent work experience.

-
Graduate of the Retail Management Certificate Program preferred.

Experience Level:

-
5+ years of previous retail operations/logistics/supply chain experience, including managing third party providers, preferably in eCommerce.

-
Experience working across leadership levels and cross-functional partners.

- Experience in reading and understanding data and translating it to actionable items.

Characteristics and Leadership:

-
Passionate about customer. Continuously seek opportunities to improve operational excellence.

-
Strong business acumen and ability to analyze business trends and results, and to resolve complex situations.

-
Strong ability to lead motivate, inspire, train and coach teams to a common goal of customer service.

-
Extremely organized, with strong time management skills and ability to multi-task.

-
Quick learner with strong problem-solving skills and a natural talent for process improvement.

-
Strong communicator and active listener who comes with an open-mind and can effectively incorporate store partners in key decisions.

-
Effective relationship-building skills, ability to cultivate strong partnerships across division partners.

The salary range is $ 80,170 to $115,000 annually. Starting salary will vary based on criteria such as location, experience, and qualifications. There may be flexibility for exceptional candidates.

Benefits may include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay (accrued based on hours worked), Flexible Time Off, paid holidays (8-9 days annually), bereavement pay, and retirement benefits (such as 401(k). Associates in this position are also eligible for a quarterly bonus.

PHYSICAL ENVIRONMENT:

-
Work may be performed in a temperature-controlled environment.

-
Must sit, stand, or walk for extended periods of time.

-
May spend long periods of time at desk or computer terminal.

-
May use calculators, keyboards, telephone, and other office equipment in the course of normal workday.

-
Stooping, bending, twisting, and reaching may be required in completion of job duties.

-
Workday is fast paced; some evening and weekend work may be required.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:   75%+ of time is spent traveling.

Closing Date:   October 22, 2026

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job classification.   They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and skills required of   personnel so classified.   The Company is committed to complying with all local, state, and federal regulations including requirements to provide reasonable accommodations of sincerely held religious beliefs and disabilities.   If you feel you require an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

The grocery industry is undergoing dramatic changes driven by customer behavior across the entire lifecycle. Consumers are increasingly discovering new products on social or other digital platforms, shopping for deals on various apps, and increasingly purchasing through E-Commerce or other subscription services. jobs.title: Automation Reliability Program Manager- Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Why choose us?
Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!
At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.
About the company
Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.
Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carrs, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.
Placing a premium on adaptability, safety and family well-being, our work model, Presence with a Purpose, offers a hybrid work environment between remote work and office time.  A one-size-fits-all approach does not apply to everyone, and teams are empowered to make decisions best for them.
Bring your flavor
Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.
What you will be doing
The Automation Reliability Program Manager – Distribution Automation is responsible for leading and governing automation maintenance and reliability programs across multiple automated distribution centers. This role provides enterprise-level ownership of maintenance standards, performance management, training, and continuous improvement for advanced warehouse automation systems, with a primary focus on case automation platforms including Witron, Dematic, Symbotic, and KNAPP.

This position operates as a corporate, multi-site role and partners closely with site maintenance leaders, corporate automation, engineering, IT, and OEM service organizations to drive equipment uptime, reliability, cost efficiency, and workforce capability. While not a resident, hands-on maintenance role, this position requires sufficient technical depth to coach teams, troubleshoot complex issues, and serve as the escalation point for automation reliability challenges.

Travel is expected to be 30–50% across the distribution center network.

Main responsibilities:
Automation Systems Reliability & Maintenance Governance
- Own automation maintenance and reliability standards across multiple distribution centers, ensuring consistency and best-in-class practices.
- Lead predictive and preventive maintenance strategies for advanced automation systems, including conveyors, sortation, AS/RS, shuttle systems, robotics, and AGVs.
- Serve as the technical escalation and coaching resource for site maintenance and reliability leaders.
- Partner with automation OEMs and integrators (Witron, Dematic, Symbotic, KNAPP) on system support, lifecycle management, and reliability improvements.
- Establish governance for critical spare parts strategies, inventory optimization, obsolescence management, and procurement alignment.

Training, Certification & Workforce Development
- Design, implement, and continuously improve formal automation maintenance training programs and certification paths for internal technicians.
- Establish and manage automation training centers to support skill development and succession planning across the network.
- Define competency standards and certification requirements for automation maintenance personnel.
- Track training completion, certification compliance, and skills readiness across all supported facilities.

Performance Management, KPIs & Reporting
- Define, standardize, and manage network-level KPIs, including system uptime, MTTR, downtime drivers, and maintenance cost performance.
- Analyze site performance trends and identify systemic reliability risks and improvement opportunities.
- Prepare and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with data-driven insights and actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
- Ensure accurate and consistent maintenance data entry for automation assets, work history, and parts usage.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
- Collaborate with corporate automation, engineering, IT, and operations teams on system upgrades, modifications, and future automation deployments.
- Support integration of maintenance strategies with CMMS/EAM systems, data analytics platforms, and reporting tools.
- Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, safety, and lifecycle cost performance.
- Influence site leadership through data, standards, and coaching without direct line authority.

Required Skills & Competencies
- Deep understanding of warehouse automation maintenance and reliability in high-volume distribution environments.
- Demonstrated experience with large-scale case automation systems, preferably Witron, Dematic, Symbotic, and/or KNAPP.
- Strong knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance methodologies applied to automation.
- Proven ability to develop and deploy multi-site maintenance standards and training programs.
- KPI-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively with frontline technicians through executive leadership.
- Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization with indirect influence.

We are looking for candidates who possess the following:
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Industrial Technology, or related field (preferred).
- Working knowledge of maintenance operations and industrial automation systems.

Experience:
- 7+ years of experience in automation maintenance, reliability, or engineering roles.
- Prior experience in multi-site or network-level automation support is strongly preferred.
- Hands-on exposure to conveyor systems, robotics, AGVs, AS/RS, and controls-based automation.

Experience partnering with automation OEMs and system integrators
Performance Metrics
- System uptime and reliability (>98% uptime for automation systems).
- Reduction in maintenance costs through high-quality maintenance practices.
- Timely delivery of QBRs and actionable insights.
- 100% technician certification within defined timelines.

Working Conditions
- Work performed in both office and warehouse environments, including temperature-controlled office settings
- Extended periods sitting at desk or computer terminal
- Potential hazards from machinery (forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, trucks, trailers, etc.)

Fast-paced work environment
- Equipment Used
- Office equipment (PC, FAX, Scanner, Copier, etc.)
- Analytical equipment (Infrared Imaging, Amp Draw Gauge, VOM, Data Logger, etc.)

We also provide a variety of benefits including:
- Competitive wages paid weekly
- Associate discounts
- Health and financial well-being benefits for eligible associates (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)
- Time off (vacation, holidays, sick pay).  For eligibility requirements please visit myACI Benefits
- Leaders invested in your training, career growth and development
- An inclusive work environment with talented colleagues who reflect the communities we serve

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.

Main responsibilities:

The Manager, Supply Chain Finance is Shaw's Supply Chain's forward-looking analytics and decision-support partner, responsible for turning operational and financial data — labor, productivity, transportation, inventory and cost — into clear insights, forecasts and actionable recommendations for Supply Chain and corporate finance leadership. This is a hands-on role that is functionally both FP&A and accounting, with approximately a 70/30 split, respectively. The manager also maintains oversight of accounting close, reporting and internal controls to ensure the numbers underpinning that analysis are accurate, timely and GAAP/SOX-compliant. Success in this role means being as much a strategic advisor as an accountant.

Strategic Analysis, Forecasting & Planning

- Lead annual budgets, quarterly projections, monthly outlooks and long-range planning for the distribution centers and transportation network, built on data-driven operational assumptions (volume, labor, productivity, transportation, inventory and cost drivers).

- Coordinate all budgeting and forecasting activities for the distribution centers.

- Analyze results against budget, forecast and prior year; proactively identify risks, opportunities and root causes, not just report variances after the fact.

- Interact with operational department managers regarding budget activity and actual results.

- Translate complex financial and operational data into concise, actionable recommendations and executive-ready presentations for Supply Chain and corporate leadership.

- Interpret and analyze financial reports and prepare recommendations concerning operating results for the General Manager, Director, and Senior Director of Supply Chain Finance.

- Develop scenario models, business cases and ROI/cost-benefit analysis (including NPV and IRR analysis) for labor, capital, technology and process investment decisions.

- Ensure capital expenditures are properly controlled and accounted for, and that savings/investment projects are validated.

- Partner proactively with distribution center and transportation leaders to shape performance improvement plans using predictive and trend analysis, not just historical reporting.

- Perform distribution center analyses and studies for projects as required, including analysis of outside wholesalers.

- Provide ad hoc reporting as requested by the Controller or operational management areas.

- Participate in development and publication of daily, weekly, period, and quarterly financial reporting schedules.

Accounting, Close & Internal Controls

- Oversee accurate, timely weekly, period, quarterly and annual accounting and reporting deliverables in accordance with company policy and GAAP.

- Guide transactional processing to include Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Payroll as applicable.

- Review accruals, journal entries, reclasses, account activity, billing, inventory transactions and reconciliations.

- Complete period balance sheet reconciliation activity to confirm ledger accuracy.

- Monitor all general ledger activity to confirm accuracy of postings and promptly respond to any changes deemed necessary.

- Review expense payments, including purchase card activity, to confirm accuracy, procedures, and approval controls are adhered to.

- Ensure results are complete, well-supported and consistent with company accounting policy.

- Maintain clear ownership, deadlines, documentation standards and backup coverage for recurring close work.

- Communicate with vendors to answer questions and provide backup to payment and deduction activity where needed.

Inventory Control, SOX & Risk Governance

- Provide functional leadership to the Inventory Control Lead at each distribution center (Methuen and Wells), establishing consistent standards.

- Oversee inventory accuracy reporting, cycle counts, physical inventories, adjustment review, receiving/shipping controls, shrink analysis and discrepancy resolution.

- Partner with the Inventory Control area on financial controls and associated reporting of activity.

- Ensure timely completion, review and retention of SOX evidence and required documentation.

- Establish and maintain accounting policies to ensure adequate accounting controls to safeguard company assets.

- Partner with Operations, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Technology and corporate partners to resolve control gaps and process breakdowns.

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead and develop two direct reports; set priorities and accountability for the two Inventory Control Leads.

- Develop staff members for future opportunities and as potential position/succession alternatives.

- Build a coordinated team across three locations via communication, delegation, cross-training and standard practices.

- Drive reporting efficiency and data quality improvements through standardization, automation and better use of financial, warehouse and BI systems.

- Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools, capabilities and agents to build the finance function of the future — piloting automation and AI use cases for reporting, forecasting and analysis while ensuring proper governance, oversight and controls are in place.

- Serve as a trusted, forward-looking finance and analytics partner to Supply Chain leadership, balancing strategic analysis with recurring accounting deadlines.

- Routinely collaborate with retail and distribution management, providing information and assistance as required.

We are looking for candidates who possess the following:

- Five or more years of progressive accounting, FP&A, financial analysis or supply chain finance experience with a Fortune 500 company, including leadership/people-management responsibility (at least 2 years in a manager or supervisory role).

- Experience in distribution, warehouse, transportation, retail supply chain or another complex operating environment strongly preferred; major consumer products or distribution industry experience a plus.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of period-end close, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, internal controls and inventory accounting.

- Strong understanding of inventory systems and how they relate to financial reports.

- Demonstrated ability to build financial/data models and translate data into clear, actionable insight for non-finance leaders; ability to build complex Excel financial reports from scratch.

- Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; strong computer skills including Word, PowerPoint, SQL, Hyperion and Essbase; experience with BI/visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and ERP/warehouse management/planning systems strongly preferred.

- Ability to think strategically and identify/execute appropriate action plans.

- Excellent project management and resource prioritization skills; ability to develop realistic timelines and deliver results.

- Strong communication (oral and written), organization and relationship-management skills; ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.

- Good interpersonal skills and desire to be a team player; ability to work with and through others to achieve desired results.

- High degree of initiative and results orientation; ability to excel in a fast-paced, high-volume operation with tight deadlines and high service expectations.

- Ability to travel among Methuen, Wells and supporting locations (travel requirement: less than 10%).

Preferred

- CPA, CMA, MBA or other relevant advanced credential.

- Experience with predictive/statistical modeling or automation tools (e.g., Power Query, Alteryx, SQL) is a plus.

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

- Competitive wages paid weekly

- Associate discounts

jobs.description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.

Bring your flavor

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

What you will be doing

Driving and leading supply chain operational and financial performance which includes logistical receiving, storage, and shipping of dry and perishable products to meet retail store requirements. A primary focus will also be on leading and developing talent, engagement, and culture across our teams.

We are seeking a strong leader to grow their career within our Supply Operations! We have a current opening in the Distribution Center Operations in Wells, ME.

Main responsibilities:

- Plans and directs the activities connected with all facets of physical distribution including but not limited to receiving, storage, and shipping of dry and perishable products to meet demanding retail store requirements.

- Ensures accurate inventory maintenance, maintains timely distribution schedules, organizes emergency preparedness plans, and controls salvage and pallet repair activities.

- Drives continuous improvement in the areas of profit, ROI, process improvements through Lean processes.

- Utilizes new technology and processes available to maximize efficiency.

- Develops policies and procedures for distribution processes in order to ensure optimization and compliance with established standards and regulations.

- Ensures Safeway policies, procedures and practices are strictly adhered to, including appropriate audit, controls and segregation of duties are in place to support Sarbanes Oxley compliance.

- Accurately records and reports all reporting data to ensure optimum financial integrity.

- Responsible for managing food safety/sanitation programs to meet or exceed both ASI and company standards. Utilizing the 5S principles.

- Establishes and maintains a safe and healthy work environment. Provides a high level of safety awareness for the team by continually communicating effectively, educating the team members and enforcing safe work practices.

- Ensure work areas are hazard fee, clean and orderly.

- Oversees all phases of the distribution centers' employee relations and development, directly or through subordinates. Hiring and continuous development of the facility staff.

- Manages employee relations by dealing with grievances, corporate, LR, plant employees, and other business agents. Union contract agreements; includes administration, interpretations, grievance meetings, preparation for negotiations, and involvement in negotiations.

- Develops a strong management team to support succession requirements throughout the corporation.

- Develops and manages distribution operating and capital equipment budgets.

We are looking for candidates who possess the following:

- Bachelor’s degree (preferably in business or logistics) and/or equivalent experience.

- 9 - 12 years of experience.

- 10 plus years of progressive distribution management experience.

- Experience in computerized warehouse management and transportation management systems.

- Understanding of financial/accounting principles and operational budgeting.

- Excels in People and Talent Development

- Proven experience in developing and managing annual operating plans (P&L).

- Proven ability to do financial analysis and review and analyze existing cost data.

- Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing engineered labor standards.

- Ability to empower the workforce and build strong teams through hiring, developing, evaluating, training, coaching and succession planning.

- Proven ability to define performance measures directly related to business and hold people accountable for such.

- Strong communication skills and ability to build direct relationships with hourly associates while managing multiple union contracts. –

- Excellent customer service focus and results oriented.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Computer skills, including Excel, MS Word, and Adage
